title: Messi denied dream farewell as Argentina lose World Cup final to Spain
facts: Spain defeated Argentina 1-0 in the 2026 World Cup final at MetLife Stadium.
Ferran Torres scored the winning goal for Spain in the 106th minute of the World Cup final.
Argentina midfielder Enzo Fernandez was sent off in stoppage time during the World Cup final.
Lionel Messi scored eight goals for Argentina during the 2026 World Cup tournament.
Lionel Messi provided two assists during Argentina's semi-final match against England.
Lionel Messi touched the ball 54 times during the 2026 World Cup final against Spain.
Lionel Messi became the second player in football history to play in three World Cup finals, matching Cafu.
Lionel Messi previously lost the World Cup final with Argentina against Germany in 2014.
Lionel Messi scored a hat-trick in Argentina's opening group match against Algeria at the 2026 World Cup.
Lionel Messi has played 34 World Cup matches across six World Cup tournaments.
Lionel Messi has earned more than 200 international caps for the Argentina national team.
Lionel Messi holds a club contract with Inter Miami through 2028.
Argentina won consecutive Copa America titles in 2021 and 2024.
Argentina won the FIFA World Cup tournament in Qatar in 2022.
Diego Maradona played in two World Cup finals for Argentina in 1986 and 1990.
